description: Implementation of the AdoNetReminderTable class which interacts with a relational database to manage reminder entries within the Orleans framework. It handles initialization, reading, updating, and deleting reminder rows, encapsulating database operations related to reminder storage.

classes.name: AdoNetReminderTable
classes.description: Implements IReminderTable to manage reminder data via ADO.NET, including CRUD operations and initialization procedures.
